admin.title: Reply As Bot
admin.bot-username-placeholder: Start typing and select a user
admin.bot-username-help: Choose an existing user. Bot replies will be saved as if they were written by that account.
admin.allowed-groups-help: Only members of the selected groups will see the reply-as-bot button.
admin.ai.title: AI Rewriting
admin.ai.enable-help: When enabled, allowed users will see a "Rewrite with AI" button next to the saved-templates button in the composer.
admin.ai.model-placeholder: Leave empty to use the default
admin.ai.model-help: Defaults: OpenAI = gpt-4o-mini, Anthropic = claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, Gemini = gemini-2.5-flash.
admin.ai.api-key-set: A key is configured (leave empty to keep it)
admin.ai.api-key-help: The key is stored on the server and is never sent back to any client, including admins.
admin.ai.api-key-cleared: Saved key will be cleared on next save.
admin.ai.temperature-help: Higher values (closer to 2) make the rewrite more varied and creative. Lower values (closer to 0) make it more focused and deterministic.
admin.ai.system-prompt-help: The instructions sent to the AI before the post text. Edit to fine-tune the rewriting style. Use "Reset to default" to restore the built-in prompt.
admin.ai.ai-only-mode-help: When enabled, clicking the reply button opens an AI instructions dialog first. The AI generates the reply text, and after your approval the composer opens with the generated text.
templates.title: Saved Templates
client.banner: This reply will be sent as %1
ai.only-instruction-placeholder: e.g. "ask for more details", "politely disagree", "suggest a technical solution"...
error.ai-only-instruction-required: Please enter instructions for the AI.
ai.rewritten-help: You can edit the text manually before applying.
error.bot-user-invalid: The bot user is not configured or does not exist.
error.select-valid-bot-user: Please choose an existing username for the bot.
error.select-allowed-group: Please select at least one allowed group.
error.template-title-text-required: Please fill in both a title and text for the template.
error.ai-key-required: An API key is required to enable AI rewriting.
error.ai-invalid-temperature: Temperature must be a number between 0 and 2.
error.ai-empty-text: Nothing to rewrite — write some text first.
error.ai-request-failed: AI request failed. Check the server log for details.
error.ai-empty-response: The AI returned an empty response.
